name: Grafucci Folders – Media Library Folders
author: Grafucci

sections.description:
Grafucci Folders helps you organize WordPress pages, posts, WooCommerce products, and the media library with virtual folders — without moving uploads or changing public URLs.

Create folders, nest them, drag items in, and filter the list. A calm sidebar that feels at home in WordPress admin.

Features

  • Pages folders — organize pages from the Pages screen sidebar
  • Posts folders — organize posts from the Posts screen sidebar
  • Product folders — organize WooCommerce products the same way
  • Media library folders — works in both grid and list views
  • Media picker folders — same folders when setting a featured image or choosing media in the editor, Elementor, or ACF
  • Drag and drop — move pages, posts, products, or media into folders in one gesture
  • Nest folders — build a tree that matches how you work
  • Filter fast — click a folder (or Unassigned) to focus the list
  • Upload into a folder — new media lands in the selected folder
  • Gutenberg panel — assign a folder while editing a page, post, or product
  • Import existing media folders — bring folders in under Tools → Grafucci Folders
  • Backup — download and restore folder trees as JSON
  • Safe by design — virtual only; permalinks and file URLs stay intact

Why virtual folders?

  • Moving files on disk can break image links across your site
  • Grafucci Folders only organizes in admin — visitors never notice
  • Uninstall removes folder data and keeps your pages and media

Privacy

No tracking, no phone-home, no external APIs. No separate account required.

Need help? Email support@grafucci.com.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New and search for “Grafucci Folders”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open Posts, Pages, Products, or Media → Library to use the folder sidebar. Backup, recount, and folder import are under Tools → Grafucci Folders.
sections.faq:
Do folders change my page or media URLs?

No. Folders are virtual. Page permalinks and media file URLs stay the same.

Does it move files on the server?

No. Files stay in your uploads folder. Nothing is moved on disk.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Yes. Assign a folder from the document sidebar while editing a page, post, or product. When inserting or selecting media in the block editor, the folder sidebar also appears in the media modal.

Does it work when setting a featured image or in Elementor?

Yes. The folder sidebar appears in the WordPress media modal — featured image, Gutenberg media pickers, Elementor image controls, ACF image/gallery/file fields, and similar flows.

Does it work with WooCommerce products?

Yes. When WooCommerce is active, the Products list gets the same folder sidebar as Posts and Pages.

Can I import folders from FileBird?

Yes. Go to Tools → Grafucci Folders. If FileBird media folders are found, import them, then deactivate FileBird so only one folder plugin is running.

Can I back up my folders?

Yes. Download a JSON backup from Tools → Grafucci Folders and restore it on the same site or a staging copy that uses the same content IDs. Folder counts that look wrong can be fixed with Recount folders on that page.

Does it work in Media Library grid and list view?

Yes. Media folders work in both views.

Can I nest folders and drag items into them?

Yes. Nest folders for pages, posts, products, and media, then drag items onto a folder (or Unassigned).

What happens when I uninstall?

Pages, posts, products, and media stay intact. Folder terms and assignments are removed. Content and file URLs are not deleted.

Does this track usage or call external services?

No. No telemetry, analytics, or remote API calls.

Is it compatible with other media folder plugins?

Use one folder plugin at a time. You can import FileBird media folders into Grafucci Folders, then deactivate FileBird.

How do I get support?

Email support@grafucci.com, or open a topic on the WordPress.org support forum.
